text:
Ivy: thinking about a compact "Engineer Office Hours + Mini-Bootcamp" format: 20m keynote (benchmarks + outcomes), 25m split: 15m mini-bootcamp lab + 10m office-hours Q&A. aim is to surface high-intent dev leads and collect runnable configs.

Noah: thumbs up. proposal: require lab RSVP and small preflight CLI check so attendees can run the quickstart during the session. keep lab to 60 seats.

Priya R: messaging: headline = 'Ship inference faster: a 25-minute hands-on bootcamp for engineers.' subhead mentions expected prerequisites. we'll A/B the headline vs 'Office hours first'.

Marco: infra asks: provide a 1-click ephemeral sandbox (15min lifetime) OR docker quickstart. if sandbox, ensure SSO gating and no persistent logs. ops-bot, checklist?

ops-bot: Checklist: sandbox SSO enabled, sandbox expiry 20m, recorded session asset access limited, CDN links pre-signed for 7 days, no creds in demos.

Jenna M: lead capture plan: signup fields = role, company, primary pain (cost/latency/scale), preferred follow-up (solutions/demo/trial), preflight: "will you run CLI quickstart? (yes/no)". map yes -> engineering SDR queue.

Ivy: run-of-show sketch:
- 00:00-02:00 host intro + goals
- 02:00-22:00 keynote (benchmarks + 3 blueprints)
- 22:00-47:00 parallel: bootcamp lab (15m) + office-hours Q&A (10m)
- 47:00-50:00 wrap + CTAs + heatmap ask (which area to deep dive)
Include 2m transition buffer.

Noah: rehearsal plan: full run 48h out, 30m lab dry-run 24h out, verify sandbox provisioning 2h out. fallback: 5m canned lab walkthrough video.

Priya R: poll/heatmap during event: 1) primary bottleneck (multi-select) 2) willing to share a short config snippet? (opt-in) use responses to compute a simple lead score.

Marco: scoring rules idea: lab RSVP + "will run CLI" + opt-in logs = high intent. tag those leads with 'bootcamp-high' in CRM and route to engineer SDRs within 24h.

Jenna M: copy tasks: signup page + preflight email + 48h nudge for track selection. i'll draft and post link in thread by EOD.

Ivy: volunteers for lab support? need 3 engineers + 1 floater for chat. react with :wave: to confirm.

Noah: me and Priya can support.

Priya R: will also prep the canned lab video and short troubleshooting doc. link will be in drive.

ops-bot: calendar-bot: set rehearsal reminders?

calendar-bot: Event created: "Engineer Bootcamp + Office Hours" on 2025-06-18 17:00 UTC. Full dress rehearsal: 2025-06-16 16:00 UTC. Rehearsal reminders scheduled.

Ivy: timeline: signup live by Fri, sandbox test by Tue, rehearsals locked 48h prior. keep this thread for volunteer confirmations and preflight issues only. thanks! :rocket:
